title: Costing and valuation instrument registry: verified research seed
coverage_statement: Bounded high-recall primary-source web review. This is not a registered systematic review or a claim of global exhaustiveness; national HTA manuals, specialty extensions and translations require continuing curation.
interpretation: Published_current_identified means a published applicable version was found and no successor was identified in this search; it is not a guarantee that no newer instrument exists.
copyright_policy: Original short summaries and semantic mappings; no wholesale checklist wording or restricted spreadsheet redistribution.

instruments.title: Consolidated Health Economic Evaluation Reporting Standards
instruments.summary: General health-economic reporting, including cost-only analyses; excludes budget-impact analysis and constrained optimisation. Replaces CHEERS 2013. Reporting completeness is not methodological quality or a validated numerical score.

verification_scope.source_access: Primary publisher, official organisational page, or PubMed record; publication details and scope checked. Item identifiers only marked verified where source table/principles were retrieved.

instruments.title: GHCC Reference Case and Principles and Methods Reporting Checklist
instruments.summary: Seventeen principles in four groups connect costing purpose, resource quantities, valuation, and transparent results. Principle identifiers are verified; the more detailed downloadable checklist rows have not all been independently transcribed.

verification_scope.source_access: Primary publisher, official organisational page, or PubMed record; publication details and scope checked. Item identifiers only marked verified where source table/principles were retrieved.
verification_scope.qualification: All 17 methodological principle IDs; not every subrow in the downloadable reporting checklist.

instruments.title: TDABC in Healthcare Consortium Consensus Statement
instruments.summary: Framework for designing and reporting healthcare TDABC: 32 elements, 21 mandatory and 11 strongly suggested. Process maps, financial inputs, overhead, practical capacity and time measurement are central. Full item numbering awaits independent table extraction.

verification_scope.source_access: Primary publisher, official organisational page, or PubMed record; publication details and scope checked. Item identifiers only marked verified where source table/principles were retrieved.

instruments.title: Alignment in Reporting Economic Evaluations of Diagnostic Tests and Biomarkers
instruments.summary: Diagnostic-strategy economic reporting across the testing and subsequent management pathway. Especially relevant to screening: failed samples, retesting, delays, downstream management, incidental findings and family effects. Not newborn-screening-specific.

verification_scope.source_access: Primary publisher, official organisational page, or PubMed record; publication details and scope checked. Item identifiers only marked verified where source table/principles were retrieved.

instruments.title: CHEERS Value of Information
instruments.summary: Use for VOI accompanying economic evaluation. Six supplemental items S1-S6 cover estimation, evidence, parameter groups, proposed research, simulated data and research costs; several inherited CHEERS items are elaborated. Do not calculate a total item count from inconsistent secondary descriptions.

verification_scope.source_access: Primary publisher, official organisational page, or PubMed record; publication details and scope checked. Item identifiers only marked verified where source table/principles were retrieved.
verification_scope.qualification: S1-S6 only; inherited and elaborated CHEERS items require the official extension wording.

instruments.title: CHEERS for Interventions That Use Artificial Intelligence
instruments.summary: Economic evaluations of interventions using AI: 28 inherited CHEERS items, eight elaborations and ten additional items. Applies when the intervention uses AI, not simply because an analyst used AI. Item-level mapping remains pending full checklist verification.

verification_scope.source_access: Primary publisher, official organisational page, or PubMed record; publication details and scope checked. Item identifiers only marked verified where source table/principles were retrieved.

instruments.title: ISPOR Budget Impact Analysis Good Practice II
instruments.summary: Separate budget-holder framework covering eligible population, adoption, treatment mix, costs, scenarios, validation and reporting. Jurisdiction-specific BIA requirements remain applicable; CHEERS alone is insufficient.

verification_scope.source_access: Primary publisher, official organisational page, or PubMed record; publication details and scope checked. Item identifiers only marked verified where source table/principles were retrieved.

instruments.title: iDSI Reference Case for Economic Evaluation

domains.definition: Decision purpose, population, setting, intervention and intended user.
Explicit alternative strategies and baseline.
Which agents and sectors bear included consequences.
Financial cost, opportunity cost, tariff, charge and payment remain distinct.
Horizon, observation period, lifecycle phase and discount timing.
Included inputs, excluded inputs, reasons and completeness.
Quantity, physical unit, observation method and provenance.
Shared pools, allocation drivers, conservation and reconciliation.
Precisely defined output or beneficiary counted by a unit cost.
Site/person/event selection, sample size and representativeness.
Collection dates, recall, seasonality and missingness.
Unit price basis, supplier/source, geography, effective date and adjustments.
Useful life, residual value, replacement basis and depreciation/annuitisation.
Price year, index, inflation, currency and exchange/PPP policy.
Shadow values, donated resources, unpaid time and opportunity costs.
Activity graph, timing, batching, capacity, utilisation and resource occupancy.
Differences by site, scale, pathway and population.
Distribution of costs/outcomes and explicit normative weights.
Parameter, sampling, structural and methodological uncertainty and dependencies.
Conceptual checks, implementation verification and empirical validation evidence.
Totals and components with quantities, denominators and units.
Limits of reuse across setting, price system, throughput and time.
Patient/public/stakeholder contribution and its consequences.
Funding, conflicts, access and provenance.
Health and nonhealth outcomes with measurement and valuation methods.
Decision uncertainty, research designs, information value and research costs.
Eligible population, uptake, cash flows and annual budget consequences.
Testing strategy, accuracy, thresholds, failed samples, retests and downstream care.
Family, caregiver, productivity and other sector consequences.
Resource/emission inventory, physical effects and optional valuation.
AI intervention role, deployment, updates, validation and economic consequences.

unresolved: No completed universal successor to the 2016 microcosting checklist protocol was verified.
No formal CHEERS-DCEA or generic CHESS costing reporting guideline was verified; CHEERS 2022 already covers heterogeneity and distributional effects.
CHEERS ClimatE was verified as a protocol/proposal; final Delphi-based checklist remains unverified.
Detailed item mappings for TDABC, CHEERS-AI, COI, BIA, AHPCS, UNAIDS and immunisation require original-table verification before being marked item-complete.
No dedicated universally endorsed newborn-screening microcosting reporting checklist was identified. Compose CHEERS/GHCC with AGREEDT and relevant jurisdiction methods.
Generic study-design adjuncts such as CONSORT, STROBE/RECORD, STARD, TIDieR and PRISMA should be selected separately when applicable, not relabelled as costing-specific checklists.
ontology_rules: Model InstrumentVersion, Requirement, ApplicabilityRule, EvidenceArtifact, Assessment and MappingAssertion as distinct entities.
Keep original instrument IDs and versions; map to shared concepts with related/broader/narrower relationships, not unsupported semantic equivalence.
Keep reporting presence, methodological appropriateness, implementation verification and empirical validation as separate assessment dimensions.
Represent not applicable with a reason, not as missing; preserve not reported, unclear and not assessed states.
A machine can verify fields and numerical invariants; human judgements about bias or appropriateness remain explicit review tasks.
Local rates, depreciation rules and perspective requirements are versioned policy profiles, not hard-coded ontology truths.
Attach evidence to each requirement and result; generate a reporting matrix from the executable model without claiming that generated prose validates the science.
Keep experimental project-specific additions visibly separate from external consensus requirements.

provenance.method: Bounded primary-source web review and editorial semantic reconciliation, assisted by an AI research agent. No Delphi process or consensus validation was performed.
provenance.verification_limit: A source can be verified at publication/scope level without its full checklist being transcribed. Search results and publisher records were used where full-text pages were intermittently inaccessible.
provenance.pipeline_role: Reconciliation metadata only; new canonical checklists still require source ingestion, source/index.yml registration and the repository format pipeline.
provenance.mapping_review: Independent human review of semantic associations remains required.
